name: HS1549+1919 protocluster, field 1 (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the HS1549+1919 protocluster, seen by Hubble.
label: q15491ir-hubble
story: Around a hyperluminous quasar far across the universe, a crowd of galaxies is gathering into a future cluster. Hubble looked here to tell which faint galaxies truly leak ionizing light, and which are nearer galaxies caught in line with them.

claims.text: The HS1549+1919 field holds a protocluster whose redshift spike coincides with a hyperluminous QSO
Hubble imaging was used to test apparent Lyman continuum emitters and remove low-redshift interlopers
